newsitem.title: FRANCE: Blind man steals car, crashes into lamppost.
newsitem.headline: Blind man steals car, crashes into lamppost.

text.p: A 23-year-old blind man who stole a car and crashed it into a lamppost was given a four-month suspended jail term by a court in the eastern French city of Strasbourg, the daily France Soir said on Wednesday.
The young man was accompanied by his 22-year-old girlfriend, whose eyesight is normal and who guided him with voice instructions during a wild ride on Saturday night.
The young man, who was sentenced on Monday, told the court that before losing his sight due to illness he had dreamed of being a rally driver.
